failed_or_abandoned: Run 1 used a delta grid starting at 250 keV and dropped zero-rate variants from the spread, so the x10 crossing was never bracketed and N=0 was mis-scored; fixed by extending to 100-440 keV and scoring N=0 as -inf.

The assignment's isotropic 'broader radial Maxwellian' approximation for the Sausage gives the wrong sign of the tail effect (x1.7-2.3 enhancement vs the anisotropic 0.80 suppression); the anisotropic Gaussian was computed directly and the isotropic version kept only as a comparison.

The <1% agreement target with WimPyDD is met at delta=300 keV (0.75%) but not within ~30 km/s of v_max (2-6%); the difference is WimPyDD's bin-averaged eta (eta0_ave_bin), not this construction, which matches the analytic eta to 3e-5.
